title: get_tree().change_scene_to_file("scene_name) game crash without an error message
body:
### Tested versions

done in the godot.4.4.1.sable.official_win64

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6650 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.13031.3015) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600 6-Core Processor (12 threads)

### Issue description


![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d5fc24f4-50aa-4ddd-9739-2c1d5041009d)

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/353909d3-3573-4e7c-9e8a-980256112a9b

this code resolve the issue but some things still don't work like the label text isn't changing and I am directly teleported on the new scene even if i put an AWAIT between label_3d.text = "c'est parti !" and get_tree().change_scene_to_file.call_deferred("res://scene/home_ui.tscn")

func _on_area_3d_mouse_entered() -> void:
	label_3d.text = "c'est parti !"
	get_tree().change_scene_to_file.call_deferred("res://scene/home_ui.tscn")

### Steps to reproduce

like on the video, do an area 3D and do a func _on_area_3d_mouse_entered() -> void: for calling a new scene with get_tree().change_scene_to_file("SCENE_NAME")
the first scene is in 3D and the second in 2D (idk if thats importante) 

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[godot_issue.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20023377/godot_issue.zip)
